hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const o=JSON.parse(d);const f=o.tool_input&&o.tool_input.file_path;if(f)process.stdout.write(f);}catch(e){}})" | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && npx prettier --ignore-unknown --write "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
